# TP x STUDIO

> Custom Web Architecture, Open-Source AI Coding, Low-Latency Game Servers, Voxel 3D Assets & Viral Media Editing.

## Overview
TP x STUDIO is an obsidian-gold digital studio providing end-to-end web engineering, game server nodes in India datacenters, 3D voxel models, and short-form video editing.

## Services
- Web Architecture: High-speed Next.js and React web applications, Discord OAuth2 integrations, and webstores.
- Game Servers: Low-latency India server nodes starting at ₹79/mo with DDoS protection.
- 3D Voxel Assets: Blockbench JSON 3D prop packs optimized for Minecraft and sandbox engines.
- Media Production: High-retention shorts, Reels, and YouTube cinematic gaming trailers.
- Partner Studio - PixelCraft Art: Custom 2D/3D pixel art, game UI, sprite sheets, and digital graphics.

## Partner Ecosystem
